title: What Claude Code is, and a first session

folds.text: **Claude Code** is an agentic coding tool. It reads your project, edits files and runs commands, instead of only chatting. You describe a goal in plain language and it does the legwork.
It works in a loop: **gather context**, **take action**, **verify the result**. You can step in at any point to steer it. It can use tools like file editing, search and running commands.
You can use it in a terminal, in editor extensions, in a desktop app and on the web. The same engine sits underneath, so your instructions carry across.
A first session: open your project folder, type `claude`, and log in when asked. Then start with a question, like what the project does, before you ask for changes.
When Claude wants to change something, it may show you the change and ask. Approve it if it looks right. Each new session starts fresh, so keep lasting notes in **CLAUDE.md**.

folds.question: You open Claude Code in a project you have never seen. What is a good first prompt?
options: rewrite everything in a new language
folds.why: Let Claude explore and explain first. Then ask for small changes.
